input.text:
New this week (Oct 26 to Nov 1, 2026): Daddy Yankee "La Postal", Dominic Fike "How to Quit Smoking", Snoop Dogg & Kurupt "The Hollow", Timbaland "Seven Trumpets", Nickelback "Everything Under the Sun", BigXthaPlug "Better Over Time", Queens of the Stone Age "Perfecth", Mylène Farmer "Égrégore" and DIIV "Zirp!".

Daddy Yankee is the biggest name of the week with 65.0M Spotify monthly listeners. Queens of the Stone Age lead the critics at 7.9 across 6 reviews. Nickelback and Mylène Farmer return with their first studio albums since 2022.

On the charts: Tate McRae "Housewife" held No. 1 on the Spotify global weekly chart for a second week (48.2M streams). On Halloween, "Thriller", "Ghostbusters" and "Monster Mash" took the global daily top 3. Fuerza Regida's "Suzuki" from the GTA VI album jumped 132 places to No. 40, and K/DA "FIRESTARTER" and LISA "Tarantino" debuted.

Which new album are you playing first? 👇 Rate them on playcount.fm

Data: playcount.fm releases and critic averages, Nov 2, 2026; Spotify global weekly chart (week ending Oct 29, 2026) and global daily chart (Oct 31, 2026) via kworb; Spotify monthly listeners via kworb, Nov 2, 2026
